extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.0.0: The first full release of SpongeTV. Browse films and TV shows from TMDB, with trending, genres, years, networks, streaming services, cast and search. Trakt: sign in with a code; watched history, resume points, lists, Next up and calendar follow you between devices; scrobbling and context menu actions. Sources: install provider packages, search with early stop, and choose in Source Select with filters and your own sort order. Premiumize: sign in with a code, see what's ready to play, season packs and your cloud. Playback: resume anywhere; Smart Play with Playing Next (at the end credits when chapters mark them) and Are you still watching. Choose the view each kind of list opens in, and every setting explains itself. Every change since the first test build: changelog.txt

extension.description: Installs and keeps up to date the add-ons published by MrSpongeHead.
